title: Apoyo Complementario de Maternidad y Paternidad Nacional, en el Extranjero y de Consolidación 2026
official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades y Tecnología (SECIHTI), Gobierno de México
duration: Paid in bimestres (two-monthly instalments) — the official page publishes two separate results lists, the second labelled 'Segundo Bimestre', dated 30 September 2026.
description: The SECIHTI 2026 convocatoria for the Apoyo Complementario de Maternidad y Paternidad (national, abroad and consolidation) calls beneficiaries of SECIHTI postgraduate scholarships who had, adopted or recognised a child between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026 to apply for a one-off complementary payment of MXN 43,876.35 for childcare.

title: DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarships in Specialized Priority Fields in Science and Technology (Philippines)
official_source: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI), Philippines
duration: Full-time MS for a maximum of 24 months or PhD for a maximum of 36 months; no lateral entrants are considered.
description: The DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarships in Specialized Priority Fields in Science and Technology provide opportunities for talented and deserving Filipino students to obtain MS and PhD degrees in science and engineering at reputable institutions abroad, developing a pool of high quality human resources for the country's global competitiveness and economic development.

title: Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation Scholarship
official_source: Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation, administered by the New Zealand Federation of Women's Institutes
program_type: Charitable trust scholarship (South Pacific-born tertiary students)
duration: Annual award; recipients successful in one year may apply again in any subsequent year
description: The Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation provides financial assistance to tertiary students born in the South Pacific region who want to study in New Zealand or elsewhere in the South Pacific. Scholarships of up to NZD 1,000 a year are granted according to the need and cost of the course, at the discretion of the Foundation's trustees. Successful recipients may apply again in any subsequent year. program_type: Government-funded bilateral scholarship for developing countries, co-funded with the Islamic Development Bank
